notes.title: Our new game "Windstop Strategy" Free Demo is Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, our new game "Windstop Strategy" will be participating in the upcoming Steam Next Fest. A free demo prepared specifically for the event is now available on Steam. You can search for "Windstop Strategy" in the store to download and try it out.

The demo has its own store page where players can leave reviews. This will allow us to hear your thoughts and feedback directly, helping us improve the game based on your input.

After the festival ends, we will begin full-speed development of "Windstop Strategy". In the future, we’ll keep you updated on our progress and plans through Steam announcements as we prepare for the official release.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3206520/_Demo/

notes.title: The "Xia" Series Character Artwork/Fan Creation Event is Now Open!
notes.content:
The "Xia" Series Character Artwork/Fan Creation Event is Now Open! The "WindStop Valley Strategy" team cordially invites talented individuals to join and showcase their treasures. Join the [url=https://link.ioigamer.net/q.php?type=43] "WindStop Valley Strategy" Elite Co-creation Group [/url] (Group ID: 897933161) and participate in the event for a chance to win a Switch OLED, cash rewards worth thousands of yuan, and more exciting prizes! 

[h3]Event Introduction:[/h3]

[b]Submission Direction 1:[/b]

What is your idea of a Xia (chivalrous hero)? Is it a swordsman with both strength and tenderness, or a unique genius of the ages?

This creation event invites artists to create original character art centering around the theme #YourIdeaOfXia.

[b]Submission Direction 2:[/b]

Additionally, you can create fan works (comics, hand-drawn illustrations, digital art, etc.) based on existing characters from "WindStop Valley Strategy". (Note: Please use existing characters!)

*All submitted character artwork can be implemented into the game through the official editor and has the chance to be officially included!

[h3]Event Duration:[/h3]

2024.9.6——2024.10.21

[h3]How to Participate:[/h3]

Join the [url=https://link.ioigamer.net/q.php?type=43] "WindStop Valley Strategy" Elite Co-creation Group [/url], and privately contact "WindStop Valley Xiao Lulu" to submit your work with the required information. Or
Click to participate through the event link:[url=https://www.gracg.com/h/xfg/] Event Link [/url] 

[h3]Event Requirements:[/h3]

1.Character artwork should comply with the "WindStop Valley Strategy Character Artwork Guidelines" (available for download from the Elite Co-creation Group or web page). Fan works should be in JPG or PNG format, CMYK or RGB color mode, 272 dpi resolution, with each piece having a pixel size > 1000 x 1000. Please retain the source files of your work.

2.Tag your work with #WindStop Valley Strategy and #DomesticGame, and share your submission as an image or video on platforms such as Bilibili. Once reviewed and approved, it will be considered a successful entry.

3.Artists are encouraged to share their submissions on Bilibili with the tags #WindStop Valley Strategy and #DomesticGame, and @ WindStop Valley Xiao Lulu, which can increase the chances of winning and possibly receive an official recommendation from Xiao Lulu.

4.Submissions must be original, complete, and clear. Hand-drawn works should be scanned and uploaded in high resolution. 

Good luck and let your creativity shine!
